extension.summary: Audiobookshelf podcasts and audiobooks with progress sync and offline files
extension.description:
Stream and download podcasts and audiobooks from your own Audiobookshelf server.
[B]Sync[/B]: playback progress is sent to the server while you listen, so you can continue on your phone or the web app, and the other way round. Listening to downloaded files offline is queued and merged later (newest progress wins).
[B]Works behind a reverse proxy[/B]: enter a normal https address, no IP and port needed. API key or username/password sign-in, with automatic token refresh.
[B]Offline[/B]: download episodes and books, keep the latest unplayed episodes of chosen podcasts on the device automatically, and clean up played ones.
[B]Podcasts[/B]: latest episodes, continue listening, played markers, search the server, add podcasts and fetch missing episodes (admin account required for server management).
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial client. Not affiliated with the Audiobookshelf project.
